##: China edition of CodeBuddy IDE, the AI code editor from Tencent Cloud. It is a VS Code fork (product.json: applicationName "buddycn", dataFolderName ".codebuddycn"), not the WorkBuddy desktop (workbuddy-cn in this bucket) shown on the same site's /work page.
The vendor API only serves the win32-x64-user package (platform token "ide-win32-x64-user"; ide-win32-x64 and ide-win32-arm64 are rejected as invalid), so the manifest is 64-bit only.

The file name embeds a build id that cannot be derived from the version (4.12.4.43368774 -> 62ef1801), so checkver captures it as the named group build and autoupdate rebuilds the URL with $matchBuild.

The 157 MiB Inno Setup 6.7 installer drops its payload in a custom {code_GetDestDir} folder, so extract_dir selects it; that also leaves behind the {app}\tools inno_updater.exe and vcruntime140.dll updater helpers, which Scoop does not need.
autoupdate.hash reads sha256hash from the same JSON endpoint, so Excavator never downloads the installer to refresh the hash.
Electron links the C runtime statically and the payload ships no vcredist DLLs, so there is no dependency to declare.
description: AI code editor from Tencent Cloud, China edition
notes: The GUI executable is "CodeBuddy CN.exe"; the CLI wrapper in bin\ is exposed as 'codebuddy'.
Settings and extensions live in %APPDATA%\.codebuddycn, so nothing is persisted by Scoop.
The inno_updater helper is not installed with the package, so in-app updates fail by design; upgrade through Scoop instead.
